title: Smoky Charcoal-Grilled Butter Chicken
summary: Chicken thighs in a salted first marinade and a thick hung-yogurt spice marinade, grilled until charred, then simmered in a blended tomato, ghee and cream gravy finished with smoked ghee and butter. Served with a spicy green chutney.
notes: Video: 'Perfect Butter Chicken at Home' on the Joshua Weissman Recipes channel (UCUAg71CJEvFdOnujmep1Svw). Written recipe for the same dish: https://www.joshuaweissman.com/recipes/the-best-butter-chicken-at-home (serves 4, prep 30 min plus overnight marinating, cook 1 hour). The video states nearly every amount; the curry gravy only, without the rice and naan he serves it with. Ranges: sugar 2-3 tsp (we use 2 1/2), finishing butter 1-2 Tbsp (we use 1 1/2). Ginger knobs are our weights: 2-inch about 20 g, 1 1/2-inch about 15 g. The 2 tsp of fine sea salt is counted at the written recipe's 6 g (USDA's table-salt weight would give 12 g). The yogurt is counted at its full 145 g although hanging drains off some whey. Not counted: the green chutney (on the side), the whole spices in the bag (removed), salt 'to taste', and the cream, kasuri methi and cilantro garnishes. Proxies: Kashmiri chili uses USDA paprika, kasuri methi (dried fenugreek leaves) uses USDA fenugreek seed, garam masala as noted on its ingredient. Garam masala uses a branded garam masala record (MDH).

steps.text: Green chutney: blend the cilantro, garlic, toasted cumin, salt, ginger and green chilies with a splash of cold water until smooth.
Cut the chicken into 1-inch cubes and toss with the salt, lemon juice, grated ginger and garlic. Refrigerate 30 minutes to 2 hours.
Hang the yogurt in a clean tea towel for 2-3 hours or overnight until very thick (or thicken it with 1 1/2-3 tsp besan flour instead).

Whisk the hung yogurt with the Kashmiri chili, turmeric, lemon juice, cumin, kasuri methi, coriander, garam masala, sea salt, ginger, garlic and mustard oil. Coat the chicken and refrigerate 2-3 hours or overnight.
Skewer the chicken and grill over charcoal (or broil) 2-3 minutes per side on three sides, until charred.
Melt 2 Tbsp ghee over medium heat. Cook the onion, ginger and garlic with a little salt 3-4 minutes, until soft. Add the sugar and ground spices and toast 30-60 seconds.
Stir in the tomato paste for 1-2 minutes, then the crushed tomatoes, water and kasuri methi. Bring to a boil, lower to a simmer, add the whole-spice bag and simmer 10-15 minutes.
Remove the spice bag, blend the sauce until smooth, return it to the pot and loosen with water.
Optional: smoke the remaining 2 Tbsp melted ghee with a hot piece of charcoal under a lid for 1-2 minutes, then strain it into the gravy.
Add the cream, bring to a boil, lower to a simmer for a minute, then add the chicken and simmer 5 minutes.
Off the heat, stir in the cold butter until glossy. Taste for salt.
Serve with basmati rice and naan, a drizzle of cream, kasuri methi, cilantro and the green chutney.
